children: Alchemy Investments Acquisition Corp. 1's net loss narrowed year over year, as operating costs declined to $215,675 from $428,114, partly offset by lower trust-account investment gains and higher related-party interest expense. The company has not begun operations and is pursuing a business combination.
: The company’s agreement to acquire Cartiga for $540M remains subject to shareholder and other customary closing conditions.
: Shareholders approved extending the business-combination deadline to September 9, 2027, with monthly trust deposits required.
: 548,987 Class A ordinary shares were redeemed on August 28, 2026, leaving 3,659,055 shares outstanding.
: Cash outside the trust account was $24,044 at September 30, 2026, and management cited substantial doubt about continuing as a going concern.
